module origen_014679(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire startComp,
    input wire [5:0] tpValor,
    input wire [5:0] tpReferenciaC,
    input wire [5:0] tpReferenciaF,
    output reg tOut,
    output reg alarmaVisualC,
    output reg alarmaVisualF
);

    reg startC;
    reg [5:0] tValor;

    initial begin
        tOut = 0;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge startC or negedge reset) begin
        if (reset == 1) begin
            startC <= 0;
            tValor <= 6'b0;
            tOut <= 0;
            alarmaVisualC <= 0;
            alarmaVisualF <= 0;
        end
        else begin
            startC <= startComp;
            tValor <= tpValor;

            if (tOut == 0) begin
                if (tValor > tpReferenciaC) begin
                    tOut <= 1;
                    alarmaVisualC <= 1;
                end
                else if (tValor < tpReferenciaF) begin
                    tOut <= 1;
                    alarmaVisualF <= 1;
                end
            end
            else begin
                if (tValor < tpReferenciaC) begin
                    tOut <= 0;
                    alarmaVisualC <= 0;
                end
                else if (tValor > tpReferenciaF) begin
                    tOut <= 0;
                    alarmaVisualF <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
